purpose: Track corpus coverage and gaps for a comprehensive email review without retaining raw mail or person-level case details.

personal_gmail.coverage_issue: The label count and search-result count differ; reconcile message-ID coverage before marking complete.

method_notes: The local message index is read-only and caught up for work and iCloud scopes.
A deterministic lexical pass touched each indexed message body to produce topic-discovery counts; these are overlapping search leads, not human semantic review or HR process metrics.
Messages without indexed bodies and all attachment content remain explicit review gaps.
Mailbox files, full message bodies, credentials, employee/applicant identities, and case narratives are excluded from this tracked record.
next_steps: Review full message bodies in bounded, deduplicated batches and capture only corroborated process knowledge or durable user context.
Reconcile Gmail search IDs with the inbox label count and review all in-scope messages.
Inspect work attachments selectively; do not run the all-attachments exporter.
Use position-level sources to validate historical claims and preserve only safe reference documents.
